editorialSummary.heading: A full December day, then a break with a Storm Day caveat
paragraphs: December 18 is a full school day for every student, even though it closes the first semester and includes high school testing. The planned Christmas holiday starts the following Monday, December 21. That opening Monday is also a possible Storm Day, so check district notices before treating it as a firm travel day. January 4 is a teacher records workday; students return January 5.

The fall schedule has a similar distinction. October 9 is Fall Break with a Storm Day designation, followed by the separate October 12 Columbus Day holiday. Thanksgiving gives students the entire November 23-27 week off. Spring holidays are March 15-19, with classes resuming March 22. Good Friday, March 26, is a separate day off after that return.

The May testing schedule changes dismissal by grade. May 25 has early release for high school students only. May 26 is the final school day and has early release for all students. Graduation ceremonies run on school-specific dates before the district year ends, while the final report card is scheduled for June 9 in the Parent Portal.

about.dataSource: This record follows the district’s 2026-2027 Student Academic Calendar, Board Approved October 28, 2025. The supplied local PDF matches the current official short-link download byte for byte. The district Academic Calendar page independently lists the school dates, report cards and graduations.
about.processing: Each possible Storm Day is its own conditional no-class event: four PLC dates, the Friday fall holiday and the opening winter holiday date. Only that first winter weekday is conditional; the rest of the holiday and the January records day are separate confirmed events. Holiday ends are derived from the published return dates. Thanksgiving Day stays as a named holiday covered by its enclosing break, so closure totals count it once. Consecutive December testing dates are grouped; full-day December and shortened last-day meanings each share one canonical occurrence. Final June report cards and school-specific graduation entries remain student milestones. Staff pre-planning and post-planning, plus Memorial Day outside the student year, are omitted. Both years have 208 weekdays in the attendance span: 26 confirmed closures plus six currently scheduled conditional closures leave 176 attendance dates. No exam-period or early-release clock times are supplied.
about.updates: Official calendar links, the downloadable 2026-2027 PDF and available district News and Live Feed pages were checked October 15, 2026. The web table omits the PDF’s Storm Day qualifier beside April 14; the explicit PDF designation remains in force in this record. Generic online all-day event endpoints are not used to extend holidays across a stated student return date.
about.disclaimer: Confirm any activated Storm Day with Bay District Schools. Individual schools supply exam reporting instructions, pickup times and graduation details; a school-specific ceremony does not make the date a holiday for everyone.

faqs.question: What is the first day of school for Bay District Schools in 2026?
faqs.answer: Students start Monday, August 10, 2026. The professional learning and pre-school planning dates in July and early August are for staff, not the start of student classes.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Bay County in 2027?
faqs.answer: The last day for all students is Wednesday, May 26, 2027, with early release for everyone. May 27-28 is teacher post-planning and does not extend the student year.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break, including the return to school?
faqs.answer: Students have the full week of November 23-27, 2026, off and return Monday, November 30. Thanksgiving Day, November 26, falls inside that same break.

faqs.question: What is the planned Christmas break, and when do students return?
faqs.answer: The planned student break runs December 21, 2026-January 4, 2027. Students return Tuesday, January 5. December 21 may become a Storm Day if needed, and January 4 is a teacher records workday. December 18 is a full student day before the break.

faqs.question: When are the spring holidays in Bay County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring holidays begin Monday, March 15, and classes resume Monday, March 22, 2027. The weekday break is March 15-19. Good Friday on March 26 is a separate holiday; the intervening school days are not part of spring break.

faqs.question: Are both October 9 and Columbus Day days off for students?
faqs.answer: Under the published schedule, students are off Friday, October 9, and Monday, October 12, 2026. October 9 is Fall Break and may be used as a Storm Day; October 12 is the separate Columbus Day holiday. The planned return is Tuesday, October 13, if the district makes no changes.

faqs.question: Are teacher PLC planning days full days off or early dismissal days?
faqs.answer: They are full days without student classes under the published calendar: September 30 and October 28, 2026, and February 3 and April 14, 2027. All four are also marked as Storm Days if needed, so a make-up announcement could change student attendance.

faqs.question: Which other dates may be used as Storm Days, and is there a make-up order?
faqs.answer: October 9 and December 21, 2026, are possible Storm Days in addition to the four PLC planning days. The calendar does not state an order for using them. Follow district announcements after a storm before relying on any of those six dates as time off.

faqs.question: Is December 18 a half day before Christmas?
faqs.answer: No. The calendar specifically says FULL DAY for ALL STUDENTS on Friday, December 18, 2026. It is also a high school testing day, the end of the second nine weeks and the end of the first semester.

faqs.question: What high school testing dates appear on the annual calendar?
faqs.answer: High school testing is listed for December 16-18, 2026, and May 24-26, 2027. The calendar gives the days, not exam periods or reporting times. Check your high school’s exam schedule for those details.

faqs.question: Which May early release day applies to my child?
faqs.answer: Tuesday, May 25, 2027, has early release for high school students only. Wednesday, May 26, has early release for all students and is the last school day. Do not use the high-school-only schedule for an elementary or middle school student.

faqs.question: Where can I find the actual early dismissal time?
faqs.answer: The annual calendar does not give clock times for either May early release date. Use your school’s dismissal notice and, for high school students, the exam schedule. Confirm pickup and bus arrangements with the school rather than assuming a standard half-day time.

faqs.question: When are report cards available in the Parent Portal?
faqs.answer: Report cards are scheduled for October 21, 2026, January 13, March 31 and June 9, 2027. June 9 is the final report-card date, after the May 26 last day of classes.

faqs.question: How do parents get progress reports?
faqs.answer: The PDF says progress reports are available through the district’s Parent Portal but does not assign specific release dates. Parents without internet access may contact the school for help getting them.

faqs.question: When do the nine-week grading periods and semesters end?
faqs.answer: The nine-week periods end October 8, 2026, December 18, 2026, March 12, 2027, and May 26, 2027. December 18 also ends the first semester; May 26 ends the second semester. A grading boundary does not by itself mean students are off.

faqs.question: What are the 2027 graduation dates for each school?
faqs.answer: The list gives Bay Virtual May 14; Rosenwald May 17; Arnold May 18; Bay May 19; MKL and Mosley May 20; Bozeman May 21; Rutherford May 24; and Haney May 25. Times and venues are not listed. Check the graduating student’s school for ceremony instructions; these dates do not close classes districtwide.

faqs.question: When are orientation and open house?
faqs.answer: Orientation dates and times are posted by school. The calendar describes September open houses on selected Mondays for high schools, Tuesdays for middle schools and Thursdays for elementary schools, without assigning a date to each campus. Contact your school for its invitation.

faqs.question: Which other holidays have no student classes in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists Labor Day on September 7, Veterans Day on November 11, Martin Luther King Jr. Day on January 18, Presidents Day on February 15, and Good Friday on March 26. These are separate from Thanksgiving, Christmas and spring holidays.

faqs.question: How many student days does the district calendar list?
faqs.answer: The 2026-2027 calendar prints 176 student days. That is the published schedule with the six possible Storm Days left as days off. A district decision to use a make-up date can change the attendance schedule.

faqs.question: Where can I download the approved calendar and check for changes?
faqs.answer: Use the official PDF link for the Bay District Schools 2026-2027 Student Academic Calendar, marked Board Approved October 28, 2025. The district’s Academic Calendar page and later district announcements are the places to check for updates or Storm Day instructions.

hero.mobileDescription: Aug. 10-May 25. Spring break is March 13-17. May 24 early release is high school only; everyone leaves early May 25. Check Storm Day notices.
hero.desktopDescription: The 2027-2028 year opens Tuesday, August 10, and ends Thursday, May 25. Winter return is January 4; spring return is March 20. March 29 is both a report-card date and a conditional PLC day, while Good Friday falls separately on April 14.

editorialSummary.heading: March holidays, a planning day and the May finish
paragraphs: Spring Break falls March 13-17, and students come back Monday, March 20. The next week brings a different interruption: March 29 is a teacher PLC planning day with no student classes under the published schedule, but it can be used as a Storm Day. Report cards are also scheduled for March 29. Good Friday is later, on April 14, so those dates do not form one long spring holiday.

For fall travel, October 8 and October 11 are separate Fall Break entries with a weekend between them. Only October 8 carries the possible Storm Day designation. Winter Break begins December 20, another possible make-up date. Teachers have a records workday January 3; students return January 4. The December 17 semester-ending day remains a full day for all students.

High school testing continues through the May finish. Early release on May 24 applies only to high school students, while everyone leaves early on the May 25 last day. The graduation list includes North Bay Haven on May 17 alongside Bay Virtual. Families should use their school’s ceremony instructions for times, tickets and rehearsals.

October 8 is a possible Storm Day; October 11 is a separate fall holiday
High school early release is May 24, followed by all-student early release May 25

about.dataSource: The supplied 2027-2028 Student Academic Calendar is marked Revised 9/8/2026. Bay’s live Academic Calendar page identifies the supplied Google Drive file ID as its 2027-2028 FINAL download. The local PDF was inspected in full; the stored content hash describes that local file, not a successfully downloaded Google response.
about.processing: Each possible Storm Day is its own conditional no-class event: four PLC dates, the Friday fall holiday and the opening winter holiday date. Only that first winter weekday is conditional; the rest of the holiday and the January records day are separate confirmed events. Holiday ends are derived from the published return dates. Thanksgiving Day stays as a named holiday covered by its enclosing break, so closure totals count it once. Consecutive December testing dates are grouped; full-day December and shortened last-day meanings each share one canonical occurrence. Final June report cards and school-specific graduation entries remain student milestones. Staff pre-planning and post-planning, plus Memorial Day outside the student year, are omitted. Both years have 208 weekdays in the attendance span: 26 confirmed closures plus six currently scheduled conditional closures leave 176 attendance dates. No exam-period or early-release clock times are supplied. The March and April monthly attendance subtotals conflict with the dated schedule; each shifts by one day but the annual sum agrees.
about.updates: The district calendar page and its current 2027-2028 link were checked October 15, 2026. Google Drive downloads timed out, so this review cannot establish that the remote bytes match the supplied revision. September 8, 2026 is the printed revision date. The footer does not separately identify an original Board adoption date.
about.disclaimer: Confirm any activated Storm Day with Bay District Schools. Individual schools supply exam reporting instructions, pickup times and graduation details; a school-specific ceremony does not make the date a holiday for everyone.

faqs.question: When do Bay County students begin the 2027-2028 school year?
faqs.answer: The student opening day is Tuesday, August 10, 2027. Staff learning and pre-school planning happen before that date; August 9 is still a staff planning day.

faqs.question: What is the final student day in May 2028?
faqs.answer: Thursday, May 25, 2028, is the last day of school for all students, with early release for all students. Teacher post-planning and Memorial Day occur afterward and are not additional student attendance dates.

faqs.question: Does the 2027 Thanksgiving break cover Monday through Friday?
faqs.answer: Yes. There are no classes during November 22-26, 2027, and students return Monday, November 29. The separately listed Thanksgiving Day on November 25 is already inside that week off.

faqs.question: Do students return from winter break on January 3 or January 4?
faqs.answer: Students return Tuesday, January 4, 2028. January 3 is a teacher records workday. Winter Break starts December 20, 2027, although that first Monday may be used for storm make-up classes; check district notices before booking travel around it.

faqs.question: How are the two October fall break dates different?
faqs.answer: Friday, October 8, and Monday, October 11, 2027, are both labeled Fall Break. The Friday is also a possible Storm Day; the Monday has no Storm Day designation. If the schedule stays as published, the two days join across the weekend and classes resume Tuesday, October 12.

faqs.question: When does spring break end in March 2028?
faqs.answer: The break starts Monday, March 13, and students return Monday, March 20. Its school-week dates are March 13-17. The March 29 PLC planning day and April 14 Good Friday holiday come after that return, with school days between them.

faqs.question: Is Good Friday part of the March spring break?
faqs.answer: No. Good Friday is April 14, 2028, and is listed as a student and teacher holiday. Spring Break is March 13-17. The calendar does not combine those two holidays into a continuous break.

faqs.question: Which PLC dates currently have no school for students?
faqs.answer: The four teacher PLC planning days are September 29 and October 27, 2027, and February 2 and March 29, 2028. These are planned full days without student classes, rather than early dismissals, and each can become a Storm Day if needed.

faqs.question: Can fall or winter vacation dates be used for storm make-up classes?
faqs.answer: Yes. October 8 and December 20, 2027, carry Storm Day designations, as do the four PLC planning days. The designation applies to those specific dates, not every day of the surrounding break. No priority order is printed; wait for the district to announce which date it will use.

faqs.question: Do all students leave early on December 17?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, December 17, 2027, is explicitly a full day for all students. It closes the second nine weeks and the first semester, and it is also a high school testing day.

faqs.question: When should high school families expect semester testing?
faqs.answer: The annual schedule places high school testing on December 15-17, 2027, and May 23-25, 2028. Individual exam periods, arrival instructions and testing locations come from the high school.

faqs.question: Are elementary and middle schools included in the May 24 early release?
faqs.answer: No. The May 24, 2028, early release applies to high school students only. The next day, May 25, is the all-student early release and the district’s last day of school.

faqs.question: Does the PDF give pickup times for the shortened May days?
faqs.answer: It names the affected students and dates but does not publish dismissal clock times. Get the school’s early release notice before arranging pickup; high school families should also check whether exam reporting instructions affect their student.

faqs.question: Is March 29 a report-card date even though students may be off?
faqs.answer: Yes. March 29, 2028, is listed both for report cards in the Parent Portal and for a PLC planning day that may become a Storm Day. The other report-card dates are October 20, 2027, January 12, 2028, and June 7, 2028. Report-card availability does not itself require a school visit.

faqs.question: Are there set progress-report dates in the 2027-2028 PDF?
faqs.answer: No release dates are printed for progress reports. The district directs families to the Parent Portal and says parents may contact the school if internet access is unavailable. The four dated report-card releases are a different schedule.

faqs.question: What are the grading-period closing dates for 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: The first nine weeks closes October 7, 2027; the second closes December 17, 2027; the third closes March 10, 2028; and the fourth closes May 25, 2028. The December and May dates also end their respective semesters.

faqs.question: Which schools have May 2028 graduation dates listed?
faqs.answer: Rosenwald is May 15; Rutherford May 16; Bay Virtual and North Bay Haven May 17; Arnold and MKL May 18; Bay May 19; Mosley May 22; Bozeman May 23; and Haney May 24. The list supplies dates only. Ask the school about tickets, rehearsal, location and ceremony time.

faqs.question: Where should families look for back-to-school meetings?
faqs.answer: Use the school’s orientation announcement for its date and time. September open houses are described by school level: selected Mondays for high school, Tuesdays for middle school and Thursdays for elementary school. Those descriptions do not give one districtwide meeting date.

faqs.question: What are the Labor Day, Veterans Day, MLK Day and Presidents Day holidays?
faqs.answer: Students are off September 6 and November 11, 2027, and January 17 and February 21, 2028, for those four holidays, respectively. They are in addition to the longer fall, Thanksgiving, winter and spring breaks.

faqs.question: Which calendar version should I use, and how many student days does it show?
faqs.answer: This page follows the supplied 2027-2028 Student Academic Calendar marked Revised 9/8/2026, which lists 176 student days. The district’s Academic Calendar page links to the FINAL version on Google Drive. Check that link and school announcements for later changes, particularly if a Storm Day is activated.
